content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization, information, or medical-necessity issue, so retro authorization, records submission, peer-to-peer, and a necessity appeal would not properly address it. The claim facts show no identified coding correction, and resubmitting risks an improper duplicate; patient billing is also inappropriate for a contractual bundling denial. A specialist must review the paid companion service and bundling/edit details to determine whether a modifier or payer-specific appeal is supportable."}
